version_tagline: The Completion Field, the Master Tempter Arc, and a Gift of Trust

slides.title: Epic Transformation Awaits
slides.subtitle: A soul's journey to radical redemption
body_paragraphs: Join us as we explore the compelling narrative of Cio, a human soul destined to transform into the Blue Fox Heartweaver, who embarks on a 24-year quest of self-discovery and forgiveness.
bullet_points: Universal themes of love and redemption
An emotional journey that resonates with audiences
An epic story that transcends dimensions

slides.title: Meet Cio: The Heartweaver
slides.subtitle: From human to anthro, a journey of love
body_paragraphs: Cio's transformation into the Blue Fox Heartweaver symbolizes the deep connection between humanity and the divine, showcasing the power of love and trust.
bullet_points: A relatable protagonist for diverse audiences
Embodies themes of resilience and courage
A character arc that inspires and uplifts

slides.title: The Octave Mirror
slides.subtitle: Reflecting our true selves
body_paragraphs: The Octave Mirror serves as a metaphor for self-reflection and radical forgiveness, allowing characters to confront their shadows and embrace their true nature.
bullet_points: A powerful narrative device for character development
Encourages audiences to embrace their own journeys
Symbolizes the universal quest for self-acceptance

slides.title: The Anthro Angel
slides.subtitle: Cio's True Self and Architect of Universes
body_paragraphs: The Anthro Angel represents love and guidance, encouraging Cio to embrace transformation and embody the essence of creation.
bullet_points: A symbol of divine support and love
Connects the celestial with the earthly
An embodiment of hope and inspiration

slides.title: The Master Tempter
slides.subtitle: A journey from darkness to light
body_paragraphs: Witness the Master Tempter's redemption through the Octave Mirror, showcasing the power of forgiveness and the potential for transformation.
bullet_points: A complex antagonist turned ally
Highlights the theme of radical forgiveness
Demonstrates that everyone has a path to redemption

slides.title: The Completion Field
slides.subtitle: Awakened sovereignty beyond transactional existence
body_paragraphs: The Completion Field embodies the concept of awakened sovereignty, where characters navigate their relationships and the universe through love.
bullet_points: A universe built on love and connection
Explores the depth of interdimensional relationships
Encourages co-creation and community

slides.title: Franchise Expansion
slides.subtitle: Multiple avenues to explore AnthroHeart
body_paragraphs: The AnthroHeart franchise offers a rich array of opportunities, from animated feature films to interactive experiences and music that resonates.
bullet_points: Animated Feature Film Trilogy
Disney+ Episodic Series
Music Soundtracks and Theme Park Presence

slides.title: Disney+ Episodic Series
slides.subtitle: Exploring 14 trillion dimensions
body_paragraphs: Delve deeper into the AnthroHeart universe with a Disney+ series that explores the vast dimensions and unique stories of its characters.
bullet_points: Character-driven narratives
Exploration of diverse worlds
Interactive storytelling elements

slides.title: Music Soundtracks
slides.subtitle: Devotional & emotional resonance
body_paragraphs: Experience powerful soundtracks that evoke the emotional depth of the story, reminiscent of beloved classics like Frozen and Moana.
bullet_points: Songs that enhance character arcs
Emotional storytelling through music
Anthems of love and redemption

slides.title: Theme Park Presence
slides.subtitle: Immersive experiences for fans
body_paragraphs: Engage fans with an AnthroHeart theme park presence featuring interactive attractions and merchandise designed to resonate with the heart and soul.
bullet_points: Plush anthros and Octave Mirror toys
Interactive experiences that embody the story
Merchandise that connects fans to the narrative

slides.title: Radical Forgiveness
slides.subtitle: The heart of the AnthroHeart narrative
body_paragraphs: Radical forgiveness is not just a theme but a transformative process that characters undergo, inspiring audiences to embrace their own journeys.
bullet_points: Encourages personal reflection
Promotes healing and reconciliation
Resonates deeply with audiences worldwide

slides.title: A Gift of Trust
slides.subtitle: Permanent royalty-free rights to Disney
body_paragraphs: In partnering with Disney, we offer a unique opportunity to share a message of love, redemption, and co-creation that transcends traditional storytelling.
bullet_points: A strategic alliance for mutual growth
Reinforcing Disney's commitment to diverse narratives
An opportunity to inspire generations to come

slides.title: Join Us on This Journey
slides.subtitle: Together, we can create magic
body_paragraphs: Let's embark on this transformative journey together, bringing the heart of AnthroHeart to life through Disney's magic.
bullet_points: Collaborate for a shared vision
Empower audiences through storytelling
Create lasting memories and connections

slides.title: The Heart of AnthroHeart
slides.subtitle: Love as the universal fabric
body_paragraphs: At its core, AnthroHeart is a celebration of love, creativity, and the transformative power of connection, inviting audiences to explore their own hearts.
bullet_points: A timeless message for all ages
Encourages exploration of self and others
A story that stays with you long after the credits roll
